title: ZeroCode: Chinese-language AI coding skills for the Trae IDE
description: ZeroCode is a rule pack for the Trae IDE aimed at people who write no code and read no English. The user states a goal in Chinese; the agent asks a couple of questions, picks a stack, writes the code, tests it, deploys it and returns the address. Installation is a single instruction pasted into the Trae chat box, with no configuration files to edit by hand.
